cause: The unit and parent task recorded python -m agent_runtime.cli as though the package were installed, while work verify executes commands directly in a source checkout.
prevention: Record repository-local package commands as PYTHONPATH=src python -m agent_runtime.cli, preserve the first failed VERIFY artifact, and require a subsequent canonical passing VERIFY artifact before closeout.
summary: Canonical work verification passed tests and gates but failed the package CLI command because the repository uses a src layout and the recorded command did not expose src on the module path.
title: Source-layout CLI verification must declare PYTHONPATH
